Whispers of a remarkable discovery race through the harbors and market squares:\n\n
\n\nMany wonder whether it will ever hatch, and what [mde_egg_owner.GetSheHe] will do with it if it does.

Word travels from keep to harbor on the wings of ravens and the tongues of sailors: a dragon has laid eggs!

[dragon_parent.GetName], the [dragon_parent.Custom('GetDragonColorFull')] beast, has laid a clutch for [mde_egg_owner.GetTitledFirstName], including this [mde_toast_egg.GetName].

If they hatch, the world will have more dragons to fear.

Travelers and sellswords spread the news of a daring adventure come home:

An expedition funded by [mde_egg_owner.GetTitledFirstName] has returned with [mde_toast_egg.GetName].

Where it was found, the adventurers are keeping to themselves.

Merchants and ship captains speak of little else:

A trade expedition funded by [mde_egg_owner.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from distant lands with [mde_toast_egg.GetName] among its cargo.

No price, they say, could match what it is worth.

Sailors who swear they saw the Smoking Sea with their own eyes tell the same astonishing story in every harbor:

[mde_egg_owner.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from the ruins of Valyria bearing [mde_toast_egg.GetName].

Few who sail for the Fourteen Flames ever return, and fewer still return with treasure.
Merchants in the great markets of the east are abuzz:\n\n[mde_toast_egg.GetName] has appeared among the wares of the artifact market, waiting for a buyer rich enough to claim it.
Rumor spreads through the harbors and merchant halls:\n\n[mde_toast_egg.GetName] has come into the hands of [mde_egg_owner.GetTitledFirstName].
